planets.name: TOI-5293 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5293 A with a 2.93-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-5293 A b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5293 A. Its orbit and size follow Cañas et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
